g.text: Spectra of successful and unsuccessful small-event trials
Examples are the first chronological Mw-A and first finite non-A case in each catalog-magnitude bin; selection does not use Mw–ML residuals.
Points show retained spectral samples; lines show fitted spectra, even when another quality criterion fails. The full atlas includes all 180 attempts.
